skill.summary: Autonomously executes research, maintenance, security, reflection, knowledge, and optimization tasks during idle time.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of exploration-mode-skill.
- Adds autonomous exploration mode for AI to perform self-directed tasks during idle time.
- Supports two modes: Collaboration Mode (user-focused) and Exploration Mode (autonomous).
- Enables commands for switching modes and checking current status.
- Includes categories for autonomous tasks such as research, maintenance, security reviews, and self-improvement.
